landing.title: Photoshop MCP — Tell Photoshop what you want
landing.description: Connect Claude, Cursor and any MCP client to Adobe Photoshop. Remove backgrounds, retouch, color grade and batch export from a chat — in one undo step. Free and open source, macOS and Windows.

recipes.title: Photoshop MCP recipes — 16 ready-made workflows
recipes.heading: Recipes
recipes.lead: Each recipe turns a whole outcome into one Photoshop history state: one undo reverts everything it did. Copy a prompt and paste it into your assistant.
recipes.description: Sixteen one-step Photoshop workflows: background removal, portrait retouching, color grading, passport photos, social variants, batch watermarking and CSV-driven cards.
